Common Questions

How long does a typical project take?

Most projects take 4-8 weeks from kickoff to deployment. The exact timeline depends on the complexity and scope of your requirements.

What if I don't know exactly what I need?

That's exactly why we offer free strategy calls. We'll analyze your workflows and identify the highest-impact automation opportunities.

Do you offer ongoing support?

Yes, all projects include 30 days of post-launch support. We also offer monthly maintenance and optimization packages.

Can you integrate with our existing tools?

Absolutely. We specialize in integrating AI solutions with existing tech stacks including CRMs, helpdesks, databases, and custom APIs.
